issues.reason: The genitive rule maps only genuinely possessive of-phrases and expressly excludes object/'about' of-phrases ('a photo of Mary'); 'of time' names what is stolen, so (Possession thief_of_time time) asserts a possessor link the text never states.

The fixed multi-word idiom rule licenses fusing a figurative phrase into one surface symbol keeping every word when the literal reading is incoherent for these participants — time is not a literally stealable good, so thief_of_time is the licensed idiom form.

Idioms are non-compositional and must not be decomposed; the definitional genus (Inheritance thief_of_time thief) is false of the figurative phrase and via seeded inheritance transitivity derives the literal 'friends are thieves' the text never asserts.

gaps_confirmed: figurative/metaphorical copular generic — nothing marks a figurative kind-predication or lowers its commitment

predicate nominal with an of-PP naming the nominalization's object ('thieves of time') — outside the genitive rule's scope and failing the agent-nominalization suffix test, no licensed compositional encoding
repair_summary: Removed the genus atom (idiom decomposition is barred and it leaks the literal 'friends are thieves') and the Possession atom (an unstated possessor link); the fused idiom Inheritance at 0.9/0.9 stands alone, unchanged.
